answer: Each of 107 aliases needs its own transponder histories, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The ivory is the wall and the garden is the gate: A toll transponder history with gantry passage logs works as the gate: a transponder passing the same gantries for years. A farm of 107 aliases must climb the wall 107 times, the nectar ledger shows every climb, and one honest agent walks through the gate once.
